CH Leaderboards scores are fetched from the public API (its latest scores and your best on your most-played songs), kept on this computer only and never uploaded to your cloud.

settings.cookies_note: Signed-in requests are far less likely to be bot-checked. Your cookies are read on this computer and never leave it. Use a secondary Google account: yt-dlp warns that heavy use can get an account flagged. If the browser's cookies can't be read (Chrome on Windows encrypts them, a running browser locks them, Safari needs Full Disk Access) the app carries on without sign-in and says why below.

setup.data_empty: ✗ No settings.ini or Logs here. Start Clone Hero once, or pick the folder it writes to.
setup.fda_intro: Without it, macOS asks separately for every protected folder (Documents, Desktop, Downloads, external drives). With Full Disk Access the app can find and manage songs wherever they are, without prompts. Only you can switch it on: the button opens the right page in System Settings.
setup.fda_off: Not granted yet: macOS will ask about protected folders one by one.
setup.fda_step1: In System Settings, find Clone Hero Companion in the list and switch it on. If it isn't listed, click + and choose it from Applications (a Finder window with the app is open too; you can drag it in).
setup.fda_step2: macOS then offers Quit & Reopen; choose it, or click Restart the app here.
setup.game_bad: ✗ This is not the Clone Hero game
setup.hint.linux.data: Usually ~/.clonehero (or the folder next to the game for portable installs).
setup.hint.linux.game: The clonehero program in the folder you extracted Clone Hero into.
setup.hint.mac.data: Usually the “Clone Hero” folder in your home folder (~/Clone Hero) or in Documents.
setup.hint.mac.game: Usually /Applications/Clone Hero.app, but it can be anywhere.
setup.hint.win.data: Usually Documents\Clone Hero (it can be inside OneDrive\Documents).
setup.hint.win.game: The folder you unzipped Clone Hero into, e.g. C:\Games\Clone Hero\Clone Hero.exe.
setup.intro: The app needs three locations. Anything found automatically is filled in; check it, or use Browse to pick a different place. This works wherever Clone Hero and your songs are kept, on any drive.
setup.song_add_ph: Add a song folder (paste a path or Browse)
setup.songs_intro: Every folder Clone Hero scans for songs. Add the same folders you set in Clone Hero under Settings → General → Song folders.
setup.title: Where is Clone Hero?
